en: Levers reduce the effort force needed to lift a heavy rock, but the total amount of work done remains exactly the same.
Static friction is the force that keeps a parked bicycle from rolling down a hill before it even starts moving.
Gravity still exists in outer space, which is why the Moon continuously orbits the Earth instead of flying away.
Magnets do not just attract iron; they also strongly attract other ferromagnetic metals like nickel and cobalt.
A dry cell battery does not store electricity; it stores chemical energy that converts into electrical energy in a circuit.
Light does not travel instantly; it moves at a very fast but finite speed of 300,000 kilometers per second.
Sound cannot travel through the empty vacuum of space because it requires physical molecules like air or water to vibrate.
Coldness is not a substance that flows; cooling actually happens when heat energy transfers from a warmer object to a cooler one.
Energy is never destroyed when a moving jeepney brakes; its kinetic energy simply converts into heat energy through friction.
A single fixed pulley attached to a ceiling does not reduce lifting effort; it only changes the direction of your pull.
The magnetic pull of a bar magnet is not strongest in the middle; it is strongest at its two opposite poles.
Our eyes do not shoot out light to see; we see a banana because ambient light reflects off it into our eyes.
